title: Relational World Compiler
declaration: Compile the smallest source-resolvable relational world sufficient for an objective from persistent primitives, local grammar, signed relations, current state, authority and source routes; materialize exact evidence only when a consequential transition earns it.

title: Universal Relational Primitive Envelope
declaration: Represent consequential objects through reusable identity, role, owner, state, pre/postconditions, positive relations, negative relations, boundaries, invariants, authority, allowed/forbidden transitions, failure modes, epistemic state, falsifier, source address, freshness and provenance fields, without requiring physical duplication of every field at every level.

title: Signed Relational Graph With Computable Negative Space
declaration: Treat independence, prohibition, staleness, contradiction, irrelevance and MUST-NOT-AFFECT relations as first-class typed structure alongside positive edges, enabling both activation and lawful non-activation.

title: Objective Perturbation and Active Subcircuit Compilation
declaration: Use an objective/event/query as a perturbation that energizes only an objective-local subcircuit of a larger persistent relational world, preserving cold but addressable remainder and exact-source escape routes.

title: Recursive Object-Relative Resolution
declaration: Apply L0-to-L4 or generalized N-level resolution recursively to any selected object; deeper resolution means sharper precision about a narrower selected world, not necessarily more global context.

title: Relational Movement Coordinate Grammar
declaration: Represent navigation as typed coordinate transforms over domain/object/resolution/time/relation/epistemic/authority dimensions, including UP/DOWN, BACK/FORWARD, LEFT/RIGHT, DIAGONAL and typed non-local TELEPORT operations.

title: Domain/Room Frame Compiler
declaration: Treat a room/domain not merely as a container but as a local coordinate frame that supplies allowed entity classes, relation semantics, negative relations, authority rules, temporal semantics, resolution meanings and transition guards.

title: Reachability-Weight-Authority-Source Separation
declaration: Enforce hard reachability/guard admission before soft ranking, keep authority separate from both, and preserve exact source as defeasible evidence authority; no weight, relation, projection or model output can manufacture missing authority.

title: Source-Defeasible L0 Breadboard
declaration: Maintain a compact VSA/HDC, symbolic, graph or hybrid breadboard as a regenerable L0 projection carrying identity, signed relations, source anchors, authority references and currentness, while prohibiting the breadboard from becoming a second truth plane.

title: Polysynthetic Inheritance and Delta Compression
declaration: Propagate higher-order grammar from system to domain to project to object to function/block/line and record only local deltas, so lower-order objects inherit applicable constraints without metadata duplication comparable to source size.

title: Situated Metacognitive State Coordinate
declaration: Externalize a worker state coordinate containing current domain, object, resolution, temporal generation, epistemic state, objective, authority ceiling, inherited history, negative space and available movements, enabling the reasoning process to reason about its own operational position without claiming phenomenological consciousness.

title: State-Transition Provenance Without Private Chain-of-Thought
declaration: Record BEFORE -> TRIGGER/EVIDENCE -> AFTER state transitions, sources, uncertainty, authority and resulting residue as an externally inspectable reasoning trajectory while excluding unrecoverable/private hidden chain-of-thought.

title: Stale-First Correction Metabolism
declaration: On source change, first mark dependent projections/memories/learning stale, then perform targeted recomputation into a new generation while preserving historical sources and receipts: SOURCE CHANGE -> DERIVED STATE STALE -> TARGETED RECOMPUTE -> NEW GENERATION.

title: Defeasible Learning Packet With Counterevidence and Reproof
declaration: Hydrate compact learning packets with provenance, freshness, negative intent, strongest countercase/falsifier and exact descent routes; learned residue may guide attention but cannot self-confirm, hide material counterevidence or outrank current source.

title: Cross-Worker Cognitive Reconstitution From Compact Residue
declaration: Terminate one worker and reconstruct a functionally equivalent objective-local state in a fresh worker from compact relational residue rather than replaying the full transcript, with behavioral invariants and source fidelity as acceptance criteria.

title: Model-Relative Click/Orientation Compiler
declaration: Hold target grammar stable while adapting representation, ordering, examples, contrastive anti-patterns and escalation to model/version/task; evaluate structural competence rather than verbal reports of an aha moment.

title: Latent-Workspace Instrumented Scaffolding Experiment
declaration: For instrumentable open-weight models, compare flat-context and relational-world conditions while measuring latent/global-workspace representations (including Jacobian-lens/J-space-like methods where available) to test whether external relational scaffolding causally changes internal active-state width, stability, inhibition, falsification and reconstitution.

title: Objective-Local Relational Transfer Across Novel Task Domains
declaration: Orient a worker with a compact source-defeasible relational grammar and apply it to a task outside the orientation examples, preserving universal distinctions while loading target-domain semantics; evaluate transfer by prediction, lawful rejection, source descent and correction rather than terminology recall.

title: Explicit Cold-Set Active-Decision-Surface Control
declaration: Represent objective-relative non-salience as typed negative space with reversible addresses, keeping a large world addressable while bounding equal active emphasis and requiring lawful cold-branch recovery when state changes.

title: Prediction-Before-Hydration With Source-Defeasible Validation
declaration: Generate a bounded pre-hydration prediction from current grammar/state, reveal only sufficient source to test it, and mark the compact prior stale/recompile when contradicted.

title: Cognitive-Economy Measurement Contract
declaration: Measure active-body ratio, ADS width, branch retention, cold-branch recovery, state-delta yield/source, source-descent precision, wrong-route rejection, stale-prior correction, counterevidence recovery, re-entry operations and verified lifecycle cost/quality.

title: Symmetric Semantic-Spatial Codec Over Shared Referents
declaration: Compile different human and AI manifestations of the same persistent referential world while binding them to common entity/anchor/source identifiers; interactions remain typed proposal deltas rather than truth or authority.

title: Earned Perceptual Resolution and Bounded Sensory Descent
declaration: Start from compact task-relevant semantic/perceptual L0 and escalate to bounded pixels/depth/frames only when uncertainty, contradiction, consequence or verification earns deeper sensory resolution, under explicit retention policy.

title: Orientation x Persistent-Substrate Connectivity Replication Matrix
declaration: Experimentally separate relational orientation from live persistent-substrate access using a 2x2 matrix, blinded cross-model runs and poisoned-prior controls; classify success by structural competence and objective performance, not self-report.
